GridCraft 0.19.1
Upstream: https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/tree/v0.19.1
Release: https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/releases/download/v0.19.1/gridcraft-web-0.19.1.zip
SHA-256: 48c5d1b101befebb3c5ba3b7a14914f01c3207934813ed07dc4251b7ae116a78
Official WASM, JavaScript and embedded assets are preserved. WebPC injects a shared audio guard (webpc-audio-guard.js) and a small entry script (webpc-bootstrap.js) for storage safety, focus, session handling and the SoundCraft Enable-audio gate. Precompressed siblings and hosting-specific header templates are omitted. See docs/webpc/craft-apps.md.
